WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages
), kept_transactions AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, oa.overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages AS ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > oa.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept_transactions
)
SELECT kt.transref,
       kt.avg_anlycount,
       kt.avg_anlycount - kt.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       kt.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_average
FROM kept_transactions AS kt
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY (kt.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg) DESC
LIMIT 10;
